h: Shabbos Brings the Holiness of the Mikdash Everywhere

p: שַׁבָּת הוּא לַה׳ בְּכָל מוֹשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם (וַיִּקְרָא כג, ג)
"It is a Shabbos to Hashem in all your dwellings" (Vayikra 23:3).
regarding Shabbos, why do I need it? etc."
For since it is a personal obligation,
it certainly applies even outside Eretz Yisrael.
Perhaps the explanation is: the festivals
are called "the appointed times of Hashem,"
like the Mishkan, which is called the Ohel Moed,
אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה (שְׁמוֹת ל, לו)
and this is the holiness of place.
And in time, on Yom Tov,
of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah;
for Hashem Yisbarach ceased and rested on it.
Therefore on the three pilgrimage festivals
the mitzvah is to go up
וְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים גַּם כֵּן כְּתִיב בֵּיהּ
And of Yom Kippur too it is written
כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם וְגוֹ׳
"For on this day He will atone for you, etc.;
before Hashem you shall be purified":
for the Jew is before Hashem.
And Rosh Hashanah is called the Day of Remembrance,
to instill holiness into the day of Shabbos,
דִּכְתִיב בֵּיהּ גַּם כֵּן מִקְרָא קוֹדֶשׁ
of which it too is written "a calling of holiness"
and it is expounded in the Midrash Rabbah
(שָׁם, וְתַנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ פֶּרֶק כו, וּבַעַל הַטּוּרִים)
(Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1, Tanna Devei Eliyahu ch. 26, and the Baal HaTurim):
With food and with drink, etc."
that to feel the holiness one also needs
in the place where the Shechinah rests,
as with the festivals and holidays.
And about this the pasuk says,
"It is a Shabbos to Hashem in all your dwellings":
נוֹתְנִים לוֹ נַחֲלָה בְּלִי מְצָרִים כוּ׳
is given a boundless inheritance, etc.:
'And I will feed you the inheritance of Yaakov,' etc.,
'And you shall spread out westward and eastward,' etc."
יַעֲקֹב שֶׁכְּתִיב בּוֹ שְׁמִירַת שַׁבָּת כוּ׳
"Yaakov, of whom keeping Shabbos is written, etc.,
יָרַשׁ אֶת הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא בְּמִדָּה כוּ׳
inherited the world without measure, etc.":
the holiness of Eretz Yisrael went with him
"Who spreads a sukkah of peace over us
וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם
and over all His people Yisrael and over Yerushalayim":
for wherever there is a Jew,
there is in it the holiness of Yerushalayim
and the holiness of the Mikdash,
For since the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed,
the Holy One, blessed is He, has in His world
אֶלָּא אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת שֶׁל הֲלָכָה בִּלְבַד
only the four amos of halachah alone
is within the four amos of halachah,
for all day long he fulfills
and this is the four amos of halachah,
that he fulfills the word of halachah.
